item.title: Rheumatology bulletin — 17 November 2026 (week 47)

item.content:encoded:
Period: 10–17 Nov 2026 · Topics: RA, PsA, axSpA, lupus, vasculitis, gout, psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hidradenitis suppurativa, JAK inhibitor safety, AI in rheumatology
Generated with Claude from PubMed abstracts. Not clinical guidance. Default settings used (all topics, last 7 days, English, ~8 min).

In this episode

  1. Ixekizumab + tirzepatide vs ixekizumab in PsA with obesity: TOGETHER-PsA, week 52 (RCT, phase 3b, open-label)
    Merola JF et al. Arthritis Rheumatol. 2026. PMID 43012507 · doi:10.1002/art.70375
    Randomised evidence that adding weight treatment improves joint and metabolic outcomes; week-52 results exploratory.
  2. Herpes zoster on b/tsDMARDs in RA: Swedish national study (Register cohort)
    Kapetanovic MC et al. Rheumatology (Oxford). 2026. PMID 43021635 · doi:10.1093/rheumatology/keag642
    ~78,000 RA patients; JAK inhibitors about twice the zoster risk of TNF inhibitors after adjustment.
  3. RA low inflammatory activity (RALI): a new treat-to-target state (Validation study, 3 trials + VARA registry)
    Baker JF et al. Ann Rheum Dis. 2026. PMID 43020702 · doi:10.1016/j.ard.2026.10.3165
    New Annals target; reached more often than remission and predicts CV disease and death better.
  4. Avacopan with minimal glucocorticoids vs standard taper in AAV (Retrospective two-centre cohort)
    Hussain AU et al. Nephrol Dial Transplant. 2026. PMID 43021516 · doi:10.1093/ndt/gfag262
    ~90% less prednisolone with similar remission; authors call it supportive, not confirmatory.
  5. Reinforced vs standard pneumococcal vaccination in AAV on rituximab: PNEUMOVAS (RCT, phase 2)
    Terrier B et al. Clin Microbiol Infect. 2026. PMID 43008934 · doi:10.1016/j.cmi.2026.11.004
    Practical question for every rituximab start; one reinforced schedule broadened responses, but immunogenicity stayed low.
  6. Stopping immunosuppression after proliferative lupus nephritis: MASSILUP-WIN (Retrospective inception cohort)
    Dolbeault F et al. Lupus Sci Med. 2026. PMID 43015040 · doi:10.1136/lupus-2026-002255
    Non-adherence stops carried ~85% 5-year renal relapse vs ~24% after planned withdrawal.
  7. Upadacitinib vs abrocitinib in real-world atopic dermatitis (Prospective registry, IPTW-weighted)
    van der Gang LF et al. J Allergy Clin Immunol Pract. 2026. PMID 43025693 · doi:10.1016/j.jaip.2026.11.003
    Rare head-to-head JAK1i comparison; similar effectiveness, more GI complaints with abrocitinib.
  8. BASDAI ≥2.5 vs ASDAS ≥2.1 as eligibility for a first biologic in axSpA (Multinational registry cohort (9 registries))
    Georgiadis S et al. J Rheumatol. 2026. PMID 43035234 · doi:10.3899/jrheum.2026-0445
    6,329 patients; supports BASDAI ≥2.5 when ASDAS is unavailable.
  9. Inflammatory proteome in gout vs CPPD flares; persistent CASP-8 in gout (Translational / biomarker study)
    Kischkel B et al. Ann Rheum Dis. 2026. PMID 43039800 · doi:10.1016/j.ard.2026.10.3177
    One to watch: possible shared target (TNFSF14) and persistent inflammation in gout at urate target.

Also new this week (not discussed)

  • GLADEL-PANLAR clinical practice guidelines for the management of systemic lupus erythematosus: 2025 update — Pons-Estel GJ et al., Nat Rev Rheumatol, PMID 43020872
  • AI-assisted exercise prescription in rheumatology: a comparative evaluation of three large language models for personalized APA prescription — Bayala YLT et al., BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil, PMID 43015896
  • Systemic treatment-free period following dupilumab discontinuation for atopic dermatitis: A nationwide cohort study — Gundelwein M et al., Clin Exp Dermatol, PMID 43023346
  • Dupilumab Safety and Efficacy up to 3 Years in Children Aged 6 Months to 11 Years with Atopic Dermatitis: Results from a Phase III Open-Label Extension Study — Paller AS et al., Am J Clin Dermatol, PMID 43024188
  • Fish consumption, omega-3 fatty acids, and risk of developing rheumatoid arthritis: a systematic review and meta-analysis — Lampousi AM et al., EULAR Rheumatol Open, PMID 43032761
  • Efficacy and safety of deucravacitinib versus placebo in active psoriatic arthritis: a systematic review and meta-analysis — Bokhari SFH et al., Autoimmun Rev, PMID 43020362
  • Early proteinuria reduction as a predictor of long-term renal outcomes in lupus nephritis: A systematic review and meta-analysis — Cooper S et al., Autoimmun Rev, PMID 43033855
  • MRI-assessed structural damage progression in sacroiliac joints of European routine care patients with axial spondyloarthritis receiving biological or conventional therapy — Steimer A et al., EULAR Rheumatol Open, PMID 43022801
  • Comparison of JAK inhibitors and biologics with respect to pain reduction in patients with rheumatoid arthritis: data from the KOBIO registry — Jeon H et al., Korean J Intern Med, PMID 43021610
  • Risk Factors for Gout Flares After Urate-Lowering Therapy: A Nationwide Prospective Cohort Study — Do H et al., J Korean Med Sci, PMID 43009150
  • Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis in rare systemic autoimmune rheumatic diseases: a systematic review of randomised controlled trials within the European Reference Network on Connective Tissue and Musculoskeletal Diseases — Vandycke M et al., Clin Exp Rheumatol, PMID 43006904

Notes

  • Quiet week for psoriasis and hidradenitis suppurativa: no new RCTs or large cohorts with abstracts.
  • New records are often not yet MeSH-indexed; psoriasis was searched on title/abstract instead.
